messages.author: 9d935d54c0e7b158
messages.subject: Missing exercises in kindle edition
parts:
Hello,

I just bought the kindle edition of this book and it's very good so
far. Unfortunately, unless I am very much mistaken, many, if not most,
of the exercise boxes are missing. Also, the intro says that exercise
solutions are at the back of the book, but I don't see anything of the
kind there. I assume this must be some kind of error on amazon's part.
Can I find them somewhere else, perhaps online?

messages.author: e1b933a0d5bbe14f
messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] Missing exercises in kindle edition
parts:
The Kindle edition has enither page numbers nor pages. Alan, go to location 1004 for the directions.

The Kindle edition has a few quirks. Reference to an R command within a paragraph is not distinguished. So you get sentences like 'use paste to combine each word.' I imagine the print edition has a different font for 'paste' or something.

Also the codes are not searchable.

On the other hand, it sure is great not to have to prop the book open when typing those codes!
